abilities.name: Shared Suffering
abilities.description: Once per round, when your partner Digimon takes damage, you may choose to spend 4 Hope and have them take double that damage instead. If you do, the attacker takes the original, non-doubled amount of damage themselves.

abilities.name: Numb to It
abilities.description: Your partner Digimon now only takes the normal amount of damage instead of double, while the attacker still takes that same amount back.

abilities.name: Every Strike
abilities.description: Shared Suffering is no longer limited to once per round. It can trigger on every attack.

abilities.name: Feeds on Darkness
abilities.description: When your partner Digimon would take Dark-type damage, they heal for that amount instead of taking damage.

abilities.name: Twice the Pain
abilities.description: The attacker now takes double the reflected damage instead of just the original amount.

abilities.name: Force the Outcome
abilities.description: You may spend 4 Hope to turn a missed attack roll into a hit. This cannot turn it into a critical hit.
